preconditions.description: Both input strings s and t are non-empty.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in s) and all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both strings consist only of lowercase English letters.
The lengths of both strings do not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == len({s[:i] + t[:j] for i in range(1, len(s) + 1) for j in range(1, len(t) + 1)})
postconditions.description: The output is the count of distinct strings formed by concatenating every non-empty prefix of s with every non-empty prefix of t.
